note: Every user action traces UI source → command candidate → canonical owner → validation/permission → mutation/operation → event/receipt/ObservableWork → UI projection → attribution → recovery/deep link. Concept-local simulation only; no production wiring claimed.

traces.ui_source: pm2-row control (toggle/select/number/text) in any pane or editor
traces.owner: PMState2 (settings store; production owner: settings schema runtime)
traces.validation: managed/unavailable sources blocked with warn receipt
traces.projection: row control re-render, editor staged-state cleared, Recent updated

traces.owner: concept UI (candidate); execution delegates to canonical dest objects (PMSearch2.byRid / route)
traces.mutation: none on open; navigation on execute
traces.event: none on open; route change + focus/highlight on execute
traces.projection: overlay list with arrow selection; Enter routes by rid/route
traces.recovery: Esc closes overlay; Back restores prior route and query

traces.validation: pane bounds; left at Index = Back one level
traces.projection: horizontal slide of panes; selection preserved per route
traces.recovery: Back button restores named location; scroll + selection kept

traces.validation: rid must resolve; unavailable results route with reason visible
traces.recovery: Back restores query text and dropdown results

traces.validation: offline scenario → degraded terminal with wait reason
traces.projection: status table cell + last-probe line; no permanent spinner

traces.command: reuse provider owner secret reference actions
traces.owner: secret store owner (PM secret / vault-ref / CLI-owned OAuth)
traces.validation: raw value never rendered; Show reveals masked reference only

traces.mutation: settings updated for changed rows; restore point kept
traces.event: receipt(ok|warn) with verify summary; emit(setting) per row

traces.mutation: op with verification; failure → rollback terminal
traces.event: ObservableWork phases; receipt ok or rolled-back
traces.projection: install card state; scenario rollback shows restored generation
